name: Groups Discount for WooCommerce
author: ablancodev

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store into a multi-tier pricing powerhouse!

Groups Discount for WooCommerce allows you to offer personalized pricing to different customer segments automatically. Whether you’re running a wholesale business, offering member-exclusive discounts, or creating VIP pricing tiers, this plugin makes it effortless.

Why Choose Groups Discount?

Boost Your Sales & Customer Loyalty
* Reward loyal customers with exclusive pricing
* Attract wholesale buyers with special rates
* Create membership tiers with different discount levels
* Increase conversion rates with personalized offers

Flexible & Powerful
* Set discounts as percentages (e.g., 10% off) or fixed amounts (e.g., $5 off)
* Apply discounts to regular prices or sale prices
* Automatically show personalized prices to logged-in users
* Support for both simple and variable products

Easy to Manage
* Simple, intuitive interface – no coding required
* Set global discounts per user group in minutes
* Works seamlessly with the free Groups plugin
* Compatible with latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions

Perfect For:

  • Wholesale Businesses – Offer special pricing to bulk buyers and resellers
  • Membership Sites – Reward premium members with exclusive discounts
  • B2B Stores – Create separate pricing for business customers
  • VIP Programs – Give special rates to your most valued customers
  • Educational Institutions – Student or faculty discounts
  • Employee Stores – Staff discount programs

Key Features

✓ Multiple Discount Methods
* Percentage-based discounts (e.g., 15% off for wholesalers)
* Fixed amount discounts (e.g., $10 off for VIP members)

✓ Flexible Price Application
* Apply to regular prices or sale prices
* Choose what happens when sale prices exist

✓ Smart Group Handling
* Automatic discount application when users log in
* Configure priority when users belong to multiple groups (highest, lowest, first, last)
* Seamless integration with Groups plugin

✓ Transparent Pricing Display
* Option to show both original and discounted prices
* Customize the price display text
* Builds trust and highlights savings

✓ Fully Compatible
* Works with WooCommerce 3.0+
* Supports simple and variable products
* Tax calculation compatible
* Cache-friendly for optimal performance

Requirements

This plugin works in conjunction with:
* Groups – Free user group management plugin by @itthinx
* WooCommerce – Free e-commerce platform

Pro Version

Need even more control? Upgrade to PRO for:
* Per-Product Discounts – Set unique discounts for individual products
* Category-Based Discounts – Apply discounts to entire product categories
* Advanced Control – Fine-tune pricing strategies at granular levels

Get PRO Version | View Documentation

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the Groups plugin
  2. Create your customer groups (Wholesale, VIP, Premium, etc.)
  3. Set discount percentages or amounts for each group
  4. Assign users to groups
  5. Done! Users automatically see their personalized prices

It’s that simple!
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Groups Discount for WooCommerce”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Install and activate the Groups plugin (required)
  6. Go to WooCommerce > Groups Discount to configure your settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  5. Click Activate Plugin
  6. Install and activate the Groups plugin (required)
  7. Go to WooCommerce > Groups Discount to configure your settings

Initial Setup

  1. Create Groups: Go to Groups > Groups and create customer groups (e.g., “Wholesale”, “VIP”, “Premium”)
  2. Set Discounts: Navigate to WooCommerce > Groups Discount > Groups tab
  3. Enter Discount Values:
    • For percentage discounts: Enter 0.1 for 10% off, 0.15 for 15% off, etc.
    • For fixed amounts: Enter the discount amount in your store currency
  4. Configure Method: Go to the Method tab to choose discount type and display options
  5. Assign Users: Add your customers to the appropriate groups under Users > All Users

That’s it! Your group-based pricing is now active.
sections.faq:
Do I need any other plugins for this to work?

Yes, you need two free plugins:
* Groups – For user group management
* WooCommerce – The e-commerce platform

Both are completely free and work seamlessly with this plugin.

What discount methods are available?

You can choose between two methods:
* Rate (Percentage) – For example, 0.1 = 10% discount, 0.25 = 25% discount
* Fixed Amount – For example, 5 = $5 off, 10 = $10 off (in your store currency)

Can I apply discounts to products already on sale?

Yes! You can choose to apply the group discount to either:
* Regular prices – Ignores sale prices
* Sale prices – Applies discount to sale price if available, otherwise to regular price

This gives you complete flexibility in how discounts stack.

What happens if a user belongs to multiple groups?

You have complete control! Choose from four priority methods:
* Higher discount – User gets the best deal (recommended)
* Lower discount – User gets the smallest discount
* Higher group ID – Based on group creation order
* Lower group ID – Based on group creation order

Can I set different discounts for different products?

The free version applies discounts globally to all products based on user groups. If you need product-specific or category-specific discounts, check out the PRO version.

Will customers see the original price?

You decide! There’s an option to display both the original and discounted prices, which helps highlight the savings to your customers. You can even customize the display text.

Does this work with variable products?

Absolutely! The plugin fully supports both simple and variable products, including all variations.

Will this affect my site performance?

No! The plugin is optimized for performance and works with WooCommerce caching. Prices are calculated efficiently without slowing down your store.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes! The plugin is fully translation-ready and includes Spanish (es_ES) translations. You can easily add your own language translations.

How do I upgrade to the PRO version?

Visit our PRO version page for upgrade options and additional features like per-product and per-category discounts.
sections.changelog:
4.0.0

  • Updated plugin name to comply with WordPress.org trademark guidelines.
  • Plugin display name changed from “Woo Groups Discount” to “Groups Discount for WooCommerce”.
  • Updated all references to WooCommerce trademark throughout the plugin.
  • Compatible with WordPress 6.8.3 and WooCommerce 10.3.5.

3.2.0

  • Fixed some issues with variable products.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce 3.1.1

3.1.1

  • Fixed cart 3.x issues.

3.1.0

  • Improved translation system.
  • Fixed an issue with simple products.

3.0

  • Woocommerce 3.0 full compatible.

2.3

  • Improved the administration section.

2.2

  • Fixed clear products cache when plugin values are updated.
  • Compatible with WordPress 4.7 and Woocommerce 2.6.9

2.1

  • Updated translation system.
  • Fixed: commission calculated when rate is selected and commission is set to zero.
  • Fixed: display both prices in admin screen.

2.0

  • Added textarea when you can set the text when both prices is shown.
  • Fixed original price displayed when the discount is not applicable.
  • Fixed the filter name from ‘wwo_group_pricing_display_original_prices’ to ‘woo_group_pricing_display_original_prices’
  • Compatible with WordPress 4.6 and Woocommerce 2.6.4

1.0

Start version.
